scope: All current authoritative blueprints through agent slot binding, service validation/provenance and forced live Trino execution (including ClickHouse-only SQL).
fixture: Local synthetic MySQL and ClickHouse; authenticated test identity; session-owned scratch materialized in ClickHouse.

coverage.variants_policy: Required/default bindings, all optional bindings, each enum value independently; not the Cartesian product. Agent fixture SQL/templates/slots verified identical to backend corpus.

fixes: Preserve value-based simple CASE WHEN arms instead of casting comparison values to Boolean.
Map dateTrunc generated by logical SQL round trips to typed Trino DATE_TRUNC.
Remove outer FINAL only for ClickHouse sources; native source retains SETTINGS final=1 and caller identity. Reject FINAL on MySQL/scratch.

infrastructure.initial_failures: Local Trino Java heap exhaustion and subsequent Docker OOM kill caused timeouts and connection errors.
infrastructure.successful_run: One worker; 1536M heap; query.max-history=10; query.min-expire-age=0s. Test-only configuration; no production config changed.

remaining_boundary_issue.case: Pay-period equality with typed DATE 1900-01-01 against ClickHouse Date32
remaining_boundary_issue.error: JDBC_ERROR: Date must be between 1970-01-01 and 2149-06-06 in ClickHouse: 1900-01-01
remaining_boundary_issue.note: Additional out-of-range boundary probe, outside the successful 278 normal-period variants. Connector-bound date limitation; not fixed by this patch.

limitations: Synthetic data, not remote production replay.
Some period/status/source variants intentionally return zero rows; execution success does not establish business correctness on all data.
No LLM calls in this matrix; it tests rendered blueprint/query paths rather than blueprint discovery or model slot selection.
Date-truncation value parity compares date-granularity outputs by calendar date; Trino may expose midnight timestamps where ClickHouse exposes dates.
